name: H3 native temporal alignment (TARA)
plain: Lines up a reference video's clock with the output's clock, then softly discourages output tokens from attending to reference motion tokens far away in time. It is meant to run with a matching motion-transfer LoRA. The node requires identical temporal grids and refuses to stretch motion to fit.
math:
Reference video rows: position_id_t += target_origin − source_origin.
dt = |time_q − time_k| (time = position/40 s).
penalty = min(strength·(max(dt − window, 0)/falloff)², cap).
score(q,k) −= penalty only for q in target and k in source rows; other edges unchanged.
